== Dreaming and Dreamwalking ==

I have noticed that people on here seem to get very confused about Dreaming and Dreamwalking. I appreciate that they are easily mixed up but I've edited about 6 pages in the last 36 hours that have all got it wrong one way or the other and I've no doubt I will see many more, so I'm going to post this both here and on the Dreaming page in the hope that people will read it and understand.

So, to clarify: [[Dreamwalking]] is the ability to enter ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' at will while sleeping. [[Dreaming]] is the Talent of having prophetic dreams that show possible futures. It is assumed that all Dreamers are also Dreamwalkers, but few Dreamwalkers are Dreamers. [[Egwene ]] is an example of one who is both, as well as some of the [[Wise Ones]] .
